title: Choose the document by its purpose
teachingQuestion: Does this statement set intent, a required minimum, a method or advice?
focalInsight: Document purpose determines its authority and how compliance is demonstrated.
caption: Document purpose determines its authority and how compliance is demonstrated.

nodes.label: Policy
nodes.definition: Management direction and mandatory organizational intent.
nodes.decision: Establish the protection outcome, scope and accountable authority.
nodes.failureExample: “Access must be authorized” establishes intent but does not specify each configuration.
nodes.detail: Management direction and mandatory organizational intent.

nodes.label: Standard
nodes.definition: A mandatory, specific requirement supporting policy.
nodes.decision: Set assessable minimums and approved parameters.
nodes.failureExample: A password or encryption baseline is mistaken for optional advice.
nodes.detail: A mandatory, specific requirement supporting policy.

nodes.label: Procedure
nodes.definition: An approved sequence for performing work consistently.
nodes.decision: Describe who performs which steps and what evidence is retained.
nodes.failureExample: An operator improvises recovery steps that bypass required approval.
nodes.detail: An approved sequence for performing work consistently.

nodes.label: Guideline
nodes.definition: Recommended practice that allows contextual judgment.
nodes.decision: Use advice within mandatory policy and standards.
nodes.failureExample: A guideline is invoked to override a mandatory requirement.
nodes.detail: Recommended practice that allows contextual judgment.

nodes.label: Exception
nodes.definition: An authorized, scoped and time-bounded variance from a requirement.
nodes.decision: Record rationale, owner, compensating safeguards, residual risk and expiry.
nodes.failureExample: An undocumented waiver becomes permanent practice.
nodes.detail: An authorized, scoped and time-bounded variance from a requirement.

nodes.label: Document lifecycle
nodes.definition: Create, approve, communicate, operate, review, revise and retire guidance.
nodes.decision: Trigger review when requirements or the environment change.
nodes.failureExample: An obsolete runbook is used during an incident.
nodes.detail: Create, approve, communicate, operate, review, revise and retire guidance.

nodes.label: Control owner
nodes.definition: Accountability for the assigned control’s operation and evidence.
nodes.decision: Separate accountable approval from delegated execution where appropriate.
nodes.failureExample: Everyone assumes another team owns the exception review.
nodes.detail: Accountability for the assigned control’s operation and evidence.
